in_hebrew.name: אלון
in_hebrew.meaning: אלון בן אבינו - Alon ben Avinu, strong one of our father
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלון הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלון' או 'אילן', ויכול להיות קשור לאלון בן אבינו, שפירושו 'חזק אחד מאבותינו'. השם אלון מופיע בתנ'ך כהשם של אחד הנשיאים של שבט אפרים (דברי הימים א' ה' 15). השם אלון הוא גם קשור למילה העברית 'אלון', שפירושו 'עץ אלון', ויכול להיות שמשמעותו היא 'חזק ויציב כעץ אלון'. השם אלון הוא שם נפוץ בקרב יהודים ונוצרים כאחד.

in_greek.name: Ἀλβανός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἀλβανός (Albanos) εἰς τὸ Ἑλληνικόν, σημαίνει λευκός ἤ λυχνόν, δηλ. λευκός, ἀκτίνων, φῶς. Ὁ Ἀλβανός εἰς τὴν Καινή Διαθήκη δὲν ἀναφέρεται συγκεκριμένα, ἀλλὰ τὸ ὄνομα Ἀλβανία (Albania) ἤ Ἀλβανικός (Albanikos) ὑπάρχει. Τὸ ὄνομα Ἀλβανός, εἰς τὴν Ἑλληνικήν παράδοσιν, συνδέεται μὲ τὴν ἱστορία τῶν Ἀλβανῶν καὶ τῆς περιοχῆς τῆς Ἀλβανίας.

in_latin.name: Alvanus
in_latin.meaning: Alvanus, shining white, or noble friend
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alvanus, in lingua Latina, significat 'shining white' vel 'nobilis amicus'. Etymologia nominis Alvanus, ad fontes Hebraeos et Graecos recurrit. Alvanus est nomen proprium quod in traditione Christiana, praesertim in ecclesia primitiva, in usu fuit.

in_english.name: Alvan
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alvan is derived from Hebrew 'Alon', meaning 'strong one' or 'oak tree', and Greek 'Albanos', meaning 'shining white'. In Christian tradition, Alvan is associated with strength, nobility, and radiance. Historically, the name Alvan appears in the Bible as Alon, a leader of the tribe of Ephraim (1 Chronicles 5:15). The name has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing spiritual strength and illumination.

biblical_reference.note: Alon, a leader of the tribe of Ephraim

data.cultural_impact: The name Alvan has not gained significant popularity in the English-speaking world. However, it can be found in some Eastern European countries, such as Bulgaria, where it may have regional or historical significance.
data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, the name Alvan can represent a strong spiritual foundation built on the solid rock of God's Word. It can be a reminder of the importance of maintaining a steadfast faith in difficult times, symbolizing a resilient spirit and unwavering commitment to one's beliefs. Additionally, Alvan may be seen as a nod to God's promise that "Jesus is the Rock of Ages" and that "the Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer" (Deuteronomy 31:4; Psalm 18:2).
